scenarios.name: Keep the only staged command in place at ordering boundaries

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Ribbon customization dialog has an initially empty Part Tools custom panel
the user has staged "2D Sketches" as the only command
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the custom panel list
the user clicks the up ordering button
"2D Sketches" remains the only command in the list
the user clicks the down ordering button
"2D Sketches" remains the only command in the list
the target still indicates a pending change
no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
